doc.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Closing of the second day of the interview
summary: Williams thanks her for the session and says more time is needed; the second day ends.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: O.k., Marian, this has been very enjoyable. We’re going to wind down this portion of your career, but as you know, we’re going to need a little more time. We have a lot more things to document. I’d like to thank you for your time and effort and cooperation and most of all patience. On behalf of the Smithsonian and certainly the oral history program there, I’m James Williams, and I’d like to thank you for your time here today.
Thank you, James. I’m enjoying myself doing it.
[end of day two of the interview]
